Tolle's approach towards emotional development conflates neuroses with negative emotions, but they're not equivalent. A fully emotionally developed person will have eradicated neurotic thoughts and behavior while retaining the capacity to experience the full range of emotions including those on the extremely positive end of the spectrum, those on the extremely negative end, and everything in between.
